paragraphs.text: In its 2009 report, Veterinary Practice News described the growth of veterinary blood banks and a practical principle: provide the blood component each patient needs.

BHOC Veterinary invites donor blood banks and veterinary clinics to collaborate in Precision Oxygen Therapeutics. Our Biological Hemoglobin Oxygen Carrier programme aims to develop complementary tissue oxygen support, with clinical teams helping define research priorities, monitoring and meaningful patient outcomes.
Donor blood. Clinical expertise. Oxygen science. One team around the patient.
